reader.reads: Read all three German places and each Russian and English thesis and link; checked the three places on printed pages 16, 66 and 67 and searched the transcription and scan for the left link.

A:R160.note: The passage on pp. 66–67 says taste accustomed to old stimuli desires stronger and sharper ones; p. 16 says the new grows old and stimuli grow blunt. The searched text does not establish boredom as the motive for novelty.

summary: The three conceptions and the link are borne by their German places in both thesis languages, and the pages read as the packet. The proposed boredom-to-novelty link is rightly left out: the passages describe habituation and blunting, without asserting that relation.
